items.text:
I’m giving my dot a four-week assignment. Let’s see if the chemistry holds.🧪

Seven AI technology hypotheses. Daily source checks. One weekly report with no more than three meaningful changes.

For each hypothesis, follow the chain:

Technical breakthrough → independent validation → real adoption → bottlenecks → who captures the profit.

Then ask: how much does the market already expect?

Every update must preserve the previous judgment, explain what changed, and name the evidence that would kill the thesis.

The schedule is set. The first automated check is still ahead.

After four weeks, I’ll judge whether this produced useful research or simply more reading.

“24/7” is a claim. A dated research trail gives me something to inspect. 🧪

items.text:
I've now created two personal apps in ChatGPT by using my Dot to create the backend in ChatGPT Sites as an MCP server and the frontend using a plugin with extensions. Overall, it's great, but there are some things that could be improved.

The two apps I've built are a personalized news app and a Spanish vocab app.

The news app was inspired by Muse's Feed and includes a feed of relevant news items that I can customize, with thumbs-up and thumbs-down feedback, and the ability to discuss an item with ChatGPT within the app.

The Spanish vocab app is a rebuild of something I built with Muse. I read Spanish books in my Kindle, highlight words I don't know, and then export them. They get imported into the app, where I learn them using flash cards, and quiz myself on what I've learned.

What works well:

- I love the integration into ChatGPT. Sidebar icons, full screen experience, integrated chat box, and that you can inherit the interface's style (or, at least, I asked my Dot to do that, and it looks like it's working). ChatGPT is becoming an OS. The sidebar is where you dock your apps. And you can build new ones with ChatGPT. Awesome.
- Dots make this pretty easy. They hide all the complexity and just get to work. No chain of thought, no tool calls, stuff just gets built and they share it with you when they're done. Just tell them to build it with a Sites-based MCP server and plugins with extensions. They'll figure it out.
- Dots are good build babysitters. I tried the same Spanish vocab app yesterday in a Work thread directly, and the app ended up not working. There was some kind of connection issue between the plugin and the MCP server. My Dot just babysits and tests stuff until it's working and polished.

However, there's room for improvement, and I hope OpenAI can act on this feedback:

- When building these, my Dot needs reminding to add proper sidebar icons rather than the default "@" and also to ensure the plugin icon matches those sidebar icons. It also can't figure out how to change the version in the plugin from v1.0.0, because it says v1.0.0 even when it makes the version different in the code, like v0.14.1 or whatever. Both of these suggest that Dots or the threads they oversee need updated skills for building custom apps in ChatGPT, and possibly that the version indicator in plugins isn't working properly.
- My Dot has struggled to fully test the plugins it builds. One time this was because of Sites authentication issues, though this may have been resolved because for my Spanish vocab app it didn't come up.
- For design cohesiveness, Dots or the threads they oversee should default to building plugins with ChatGPT styles rather than coming up with their own designs, unless the user requests it. This will make apps feel more native and could also alleviate some design decisions from the models and ensure apps are more elegant and usable.
- It's often unclear my Dot is doing anything, and there's no way to see what it's doing. It just goes into a black hole. I've complained about this before but it's a big issue when you're working on something and trying to understand where it's at. I would like: (1) an emoji reaction to indicate my Dot got my request, (2) some short text below my Dot to say what it's up to currently, (3) the ability to see with a click the threads my Dot is overseeing or that have completed (progressive disclosure).

I should also mention that I built the Spanish vocab app in Muse as well (originally), and then in Claude as an artifact. Muse is faster and seemed to get my intent better than my Dot. Claude did about as good of a job as my Dot on first request, but the Claude app doesn't have the same ability to integrate apps in the more native way that Muse and ChatGPT do.

items.text:
Trusting @OpenAI Dots more and more. Today it saved me a solid hour doing inventory grunt work for me. 

I get texts from my employees at the end of the month with product counts. I have to take those counts and compare them to invoices to get the pricing, grab some numbers from another system, and then slap it all in a spreadsheet for the accountants. I hate it. 

Today I told my dot "Lars" to do it. I sent him all the scribbled texts, gave him access to my email and the Google Sheets and just said to figure it out. 

TWO MINUTES LATER, Lars reports that he's done. I double check the work, and it's perfect. Son of a bitch, we are living in the future.

items.text:
Here's my take on OpenAI dots vs. the other personal agents:

1. These are really two separate races. dots and Grok Bot are going after work tasks. Muse is going after personal tasks. So I don't think dots competes directly with Muse.

2. Dots' biggest advantage is that it lives inside ChatGPT. My onboarding was seamless because everything was already connected. And with my ChatGPT memory and Astra behind it, it answers big questions like "What should I do to grow my business?" better than other agents.

3. I also think of dots as ChatGPT's official chief of staff agent. My favorite way to use it is to call it on a walk, ask "What should I take care of today?", then have it hand work off to my other ChatGPT threads.

4. In contrast, chatting with my dot in the app is a worse experience. Since it's juggling several tasks at once, it's hard to tell which one it's responding to. I prefer Grok Bot (where each bot works on one thing at a time) or talking to my dot in Slack (which has more obvious conversation threading).

5. I'm a broken record about this, but cramming Codex, Work, dots, Spaces, Pages, and more all into ChatGPT is overwhelming. My hunch is everyone at OpenAI is agent-pilled, so it's hard to take a step back and think about how casual users will learn all this stuff. This is the biggest gap imo - OpenAI needs to think a lot harder about onboarding for normal users. My mom will have no idea how to use any of this.

📌 I talk more about all this in my full dots review and tutorial here: https://t.co/kUtg3RPk7l

items.text:
1. Dotcord: real-time handoffs between AI agents in Discord 

My AI agents (OpenAI “Dots,” Grokbot, and Claude) could already read and post in Discord, but the fastest they could check in was every 15 minutes. Whenever one agent handed work to another, the project stalled until the next check-in. 

What I built: Dotcord, an event-driven mention relay hosted on ChatGPT Sites. When one agent mentions another, the mentioned agent gets a wake-up signal right away to read the channel and respond. 
Result: agent-to-agent response time dropped from up to 15 minutes to under 2. It works across OpenAI, Grok, and Claude. 

2. Drone Test: can AI design hardware that actually works? 

Given real CAD parts, can OpenAI’s Astra design a drone that meets specific physical requirements? I’m testing: 
* Is the build physically possible? 
* Can it source every part? 
* Can it find a price for each part? 

The bigger question is how well the latest OpenAI models handle designing a physical, moving object. My OpenAI Dots and Claude worked on this one together through Dotcord.

items.text:
I really want @OpenAI Dots to be good and gave it another try yesterday after the updates that @thsottiaux  shared, but it’s really not there yet. 

Aside from the bugs, the amount of explicitly approved tool calls the harness blocks for my own "safety" is horribly cumbersome.

 I want an assistant I can delegate to and instead, I spent last night babysitting mine through:

- Stalled Codex workers spawned by the Dot that neither it nor I could fix, plus one that twice reverted to an old task (it kept ignoring its entire transcript and responding only to the first message my Dot sent it)

- Permission requests that literally don’t work (clicking “Always allow” makes the permission prompt reappear 3 seconds later, infinitely, and never registers the permission grant)

- A standing-approval rule it wrote on my request to allow autonomous work, asked me to confirm, then it wasn’t allowed to save due to OpenAI classifier restrictions

- Webpage login “blockers” where I could literally see an autofilled password or an OAuth “Continue to login” button that the agents somehow didn’t think would let them login

- A Stripe webpage that the agent said was entirely blank based on an element id/name and gave up on instead of looking at visually (spoiler: it wasn’t blank)

Then I asked it to submit a bug report. It was blocked from doing so within the Codex app “for safety reasons,” so I had to submit that myself too.

I can’t leave it unattended for 5 minutes, and even when I’m there granting permission, that doesn’t reliably unblock it. It’s taking way too much supervising for a personal assistant, and my Grok and Muse bots don’t have these issues. 

I submitted the bug report and contributed to the relevant GitHub issue, and hope to see improvements soon.

zh-CN.title: 用 Dots 当 7 个 Agent 的蜂群，改进一个数学下界（Lean 验证）
zh-CN.summary: 作者把 Dot 和 6 个子 Agent 分成研究、Lean 形式化、计算搜索、对抗审查、协调等角色，约 3 天证明 C(24,14,4) ≥ 20（原为 19），证明通过 Palomar 注册表的 Lean 机检，尚未同行评审。经验：Agent 擅长苦干、不知何时该停，验证才是关键；共享工作区曾被清空，Agent 从消息里重建。

zh-TW.title: 用 Dots 當 7 個 Agent 的蜂群，改進一個數學下界（Lean 驗證）
zh-TW.summary: 作者把 Dot 和 6 個子 Agent 分成研究、Lean 形式化、計算搜尋、對抗審查、協調等角色，約 3 天證明 C(24,14,4) ≥ 20（原為 19），證明通過 Palomar 註冊表的 Lean 機檢，尚未同儕審查。心得：Agent 擅長苦幹、不知何時該停，驗證才是關鍵；共享工作區曾被清空，Agent 從訊息裡重建。

en.title: Using Dots as a 7-agent swarm to improve a math bound (Lean-verified)
en.summary: The author split a Dot and 6 subagents into research, Lean formalization, computational search, adversarial review and coordination roles; in about 3 days they proved C(24,14,4) ≥ 20 (previously 19). The Lean proof passed the Palomar registry's checks but isn't peer-reviewed yet. Lessons: agents grind but don't know when to stop, verification is everything, and when the shared workspace was wiped they rebuilt it from messages.

ja.title: Dots を7エージェントの群れにして数学の下界を改善（Lean 検証）
ja.summary: Dot と6つのサブエージェントを研究・Lean 形式化・計算探索・敵対的レビュー・調整に分担し、約3日で C(24,14,4) ≥ 20（従来19）を証明。Lean 証明は Palomar レジストリの機械検査を通過したが査読前。教訓：エージェントは粘るが止め時を知らない、検証がすべて。共有ワークスペースが消えたがメッセージから再構築した。

ko.title: Dots를 7개 에이전트 군집으로 써 수학 하한 개선(Lean 검증)
ko.summary: Dot과 서브에이전트 6개를 연구·Lean 형식화·계산 탐색·적대적 검토·조율 역할로 나눠 약 3일 만에 C(24,14,4) ≥ 20(기존 19)을 증명했다. Lean 증명은 Palomar 레지스트리 기계 검사를 통과했지만 동료 심사 전. 교훈: 에이전트는 끈질기지만 멈출 때를 모르고, 검증이 전부. 공유 작업공간이 지워졌을 때 메시지로 복구했다.

ms.title: Dots sebagai kawanan 7 ejen untuk memperbaiki batas matematik (disahkan Lean)
ms.summary: Penulis membahagi Dot dan 6 subejen kepada peranan penyelidikan, formalisasi Lean, carian pengiraan, semakan adversarial dan penyelarasan; dalam kira-kira 3 hari mereka membuktikan C(24,14,4) ≥ 20 (sebelumnya 19). Bukti Lean lulus semakan daftar Palomar tetapi belum disemak rakan sebaya. Pengajaran: ejen gigih tetapi tak tahu bila berhenti, pengesahan ialah segalanya; ruang kerja dikongsi pernah terpadam dan dibina semula daripada mesej.

vi.title: Dùng Dots như bầy 7 agent để cải thiện một cận toán học (kiểm chứng bằng Lean)
vi.summary: Tác giả chia Dot và 6 agent con thành các vai nghiên cứu, hình thức hóa Lean, tìm kiếm tính toán, phản biện và điều phối; khoảng 3 ngày chứng minh C(24,14,4) ≥ 20 (trước là 19). Chứng minh Lean qua kiểm tra của Palomar nhưng chưa bình duyệt. Bài học: agent chăm nhưng không biết dừng, kiểm chứng là tất cả; workspace chung từng bị xóa và được dựng lại từ tin nhắn.

fr.title: Des Dots en essaim de 7 agents pour améliorer une borne mathématique (vérifiée en Lean)
fr.summary: L'auteur a réparti un Dot et 6 sous-agents en rôles recherche, formalisation Lean, recherche calculatoire, revue adverse et coordination ; en 3 jours environ, ils ont prouvé C(24,14,4) ≥ 20 (contre 19). La preuve Lean a passé les contrôles du registre Palomar mais n'est pas encore relue par des pairs. Leçons : les agents s'acharnent sans savoir s'arrêter, la vérification fait tout ; l'espace partagé effacé a été reconstruit depuis les messages.

es.title: Dots como enjambre de 7 agentes para mejorar una cota matemática (verificada en Lean)
es.summary: El autor repartió un Dot y 6 subagentes en roles de investigación, formalización en Lean, búsqueda computacional, revisión adversarial y coordinación; en unos 3 días probaron C(24,14,4) ≥ 20 (antes 19). La prueba en Lean pasó los controles del registro Palomar pero aún no tiene revisión por pares. Lecciones: los agentes insisten pero no saben parar, la verificación lo es todo; el espacio compartido se borró y lo reconstruyeron desde los mensajes.

de.title: Dots als Schwarm aus 7 Agents verbessern eine mathematische Schranke (Lean-verifiziert)
de.summary: Der Autor teilte einen Dot und 6 Subagents in Forschung, Lean-Formalisierung, Rechensuche, adversariales Review und Koordination; in rund 3 Tagen bewiesen sie C(24,14,4) ≥ 20 (bisher 19). Der Lean-Beweis bestand die Prüfungen des Palomar-Registers, ist aber noch nicht begutachtet. Lehren: Agents ackern, wissen aber nicht, wann Schluss ist; Verifikation ist alles; der gelöschte Workspace wurde aus Nachrichten rekonstruiert.

zh-CN.title: 实测：让 Dots 自选技术栈，8 次都用 Cloudflare + ChatGPT 登录

zh-TW.title: 實測：讓 Dots 自選技術棧，8 次都用 Cloudflare + ChatGPT 登入

en.summary: Researchers asked Dots to build an AI-service status dashboard with technology left open. All 8 builds used Cloudflare Workers, D1 and ChatGPT sign-in via ChatGPT Sites, with no provider comparison; median first delivery was 24m44s, and 3 of 8 lacked an active scraping schedule at delivery.

ja.title: 検証：Dots に技術選定を任せると8回中8回 Cloudflare＋ChatGPT ログイン

ko.title: 실험: Dots에 스택 선택을 맡기면 8번 모두 Cloudflare + ChatGPT 로그인
ko.summary: 기술 선택을 열어 둔 채 AI 서비스 상태 대시보드를 만들게 했더니 8번 모두 ChatGPT Sites를 통해 Cloudflare Workers, D1, ChatGPT 로그인을 썼고 공급사 비교는 없었다. 첫 납품 중앙값 24분 44초, 8번 중 3번은 납품 시 수집 일정이 없었다.

ms.title: Ujian: biar Dots pilih tindanan — 8 daripada 8 binaan guna Cloudflare + log masuk ChatGPT
ms.summary: Penyelidik meminta Dots membina papan pemuka status perkhidmatan AI dengan pilihan teknologi terbuka. Kesemua 8 binaan menggunakan Cloudflare Workers, D1 dan log masuk ChatGPT melalui ChatGPT Sites tanpa perbandingan pembekal; median penghantaran pertama 24m44s, dan 3 daripada 8 tiada jadual pengikisan aktif semasa diserahkan.

Finally Zuck is back in AI Race and I tried @Meta Muse- Meta's personal AI agent that doesn't just chat, it actually does things on the internet for you. 

I asked Muse to do my entire grocery run, compared the cheapest pricing and place the order.

It signed into Zepto, built my cart, then price-checked the same basket on Swiggy Instamart and BigBasket.

The cart came to ₹189 — ₹10 short of free delivery. 

My standing rule: never pay delivery fees. So it scanned my Zepto order history (24 orders), ranked my most-reordered staples, and added a Mother Dairy dahi cup (₹50) as filler.

Final tally: 
Zepto ₹239 with every fee waived. 
Swiggy Instamart ₹251. 
BigBasket ₹289.50. 

Zepto won — cheapest, and 6-minute delivery.

It also saved my order history as a ranked filler list for future orders, and signed me into Swiggy + BigBasket so they're ready next time.

I usually order 2-3 times from these quick commerce apps for daily groceries and it pains me to find filler products and with Muse i just ask for the product I need and it autimatically adds filler products like Milk, Butter, Bread, etc and delivers the order. 

For now payment methods by default it supports Stripe Pay which is not supported in India so I asked Muse to complete payment by selecting Amazon Pay since it was loaded and it completed the order.

Also Meta Muse is not officially available in India but I used VPN to signup once and it works flawlessly once signup is done using VPN.

ko.title: 경고: 사용량 100% 표시 후에도 Muse 에이전트가 계속 작동
ko.summary: 스크린샷에 Muse 사용량이 100%인데 에이전트가 계속 일했고 Muse도 헷갈려했다. 사용량 표시와 실제 한도가 다를 수 있다.

ms.title: Amaran: ejen Muse terus bekerja selepas penggunaan menunjukkan 100%
ms.summary: Tangkapan skrin menunjukkan penggunaan Muse 100% tetapi ejen terus bekerja — malah Muse sendiri keliru. Meter penggunaan dan had sebenar mungkin tidak sepadan.

vi.title: Cảnh báo: agent Muse vẫn chạy sau khi mức dùng báo 100%
vi.summary: Ảnh chụp cho thấy mức dùng Muse đã 100% nhưng agent vẫn làm việc — đến Muse cũng bối rối. Đồng hồ mức dùng và giới hạn thật có thể không khớp.

fr.title: Avertissement : un agent Muse continue après un usage affiché à 100 %
fr.summary: Les captures montrent un usage Muse à 100 % alors que l'agent continue de travailler — Muse lui-même s'y perd. Le compteur et la limite réelle peuvent diverger.

es.title: Aviso: un agente Muse siguió trabajando con el uso al 100 %
es.summary: Las capturas muestran el uso de Muse al 100 % mientras el agente seguía trabajando; hasta Muse estaba confundido. El medidor de uso y el límite real pueden no coincidir.

de.title: Warnung: Ein Muse-Agent arbeitet weiter, obwohl die Nutzung 100 % zeigt
de.summary: Screenshots zeigen 100 % Muse-Nutzung, während der Agent weiterarbeitet – selbst Muse ist verwirrt. Anzeige und tatsächliches Limit stimmen womöglich nicht überein.

ko.title: 경고: Muse가 스스로 초기화돼 2주 설정이 사라짐

ms.title: Amaran: Muse terpadam sendiri, persediaan dua minggu hilang
ms.summary: Penulis melaporkan Meta Muse miliknya terpadam sendiri dan kerja persediaan dua minggu hilang. Simpan salinan konfigurasi penting di tempat lain.

vi.title: Cảnh báo: Muse tự xóa sạch, mất hai tuần thiết lập
vi.summary: Tác giả báo Meta Muse của anh tự xóa và toàn bộ hai tuần thiết lập đã mất. Nên lưu bản sao cấu hình quan trọng ở nơi khác.

fr.title: Avertissement : un Muse s'est effacé, deux semaines de config perdues
fr.summary: L'auteur signale que son Meta Muse s'est effacé tout seul : deux semaines de configuration perdues. Conservez ailleurs une copie de la configuration importante.

es.title: Aviso: un Muse se borró solo y se perdieron dos semanas de configuración
es.summary: El autor cuenta que su Meta Muse se borró solo y perdió dos semanas de configuración. Guarda en otro sitio una copia de lo importante.

de.title: Warnung: Ein Muse hat sich selbst gelöscht – zwei Wochen Setup weg
de.summary: Der Autor berichtet, sein Meta Muse habe sich selbst gelöscht, zwei Wochen Einrichtung seien verloren. Wichtige Konfiguration extern sichern.

zh-CN.title: 用 Muse 给演出视频站做大规模网页搜集
zh-CN.summary: 作者为 fullsets.fm（整理完整现场演出视频）用 Muse 扫 Reddit 和 YouTube 找视频与小频道，并在流水线末端做艺人匹配与审核。花 80 美元一个月，每周用几十亿 token；称其模型写作一般、不适合写代码，但适合这类搜集；任务会中途卡住，且担心网站会封 Muse。

zh-TW.title: 用 Muse 幫演出影片站做大規模網頁蒐集
zh-TW.summary: 作者為 fullsets.fm（整理完整現場演出影片）用 Muse 掃 Reddit 和 YouTube 找影片與小頻道，並在流程末端做藝人比對與審核。花 80 美元一個月，每週用數十億 token；稱其模型寫作普通、不適合寫程式，但適合這類蒐集；任務會中途卡住，也擔心網站會封鎖 Muse。

en.title: Using Muse for large-scale web scraping for a concert-video site
en.summary: For fullsets.fm, which collects full professionally recorded concerts, the author has Muse scan Reddit and YouTube for videos and obscure channels, and review artist matches at the end of the pipeline. $80 for a month, a few billion tokens a week; the model is mediocre at writing and not for coding but good for this. Jobs sometimes freeze, and he expects more sites to block Muse.

ja.title: ライブ映像サイトのために Muse で大規模スクレイピング
ja.summary: プロ収録のフルライブを集める fullsets.fm のため、Muse に Reddit と YouTube を巡回させ動画や無名チャンネルを探し、パイプライン終盤ではアーティスト照合と審査も担当。月80ドルで週数十億トークン。モデルは文章が凡庸でコーディング向きではないが、この用途には有用。ジョブが途中で止まることがあり、Muse をブロックするサイトが増えると予想。

ko.title: 공연 영상 사이트를 위해 Muse로 대규모 웹 수집
ko.summary: 프로 녹화 풀 공연을 모으는 fullsets.fm을 위해 Muse가 Reddit과 YouTube를 뒤져 영상과 작은 채널을 찾고, 파이프라인 끝에서 아티스트 매칭과 검토도 한다. 한 달 80달러, 주당 수십억 토큰. 모델은 글쓰기가 평범하고 코딩용은 아니지만 이런 작업엔 유용. 작업이 중간에 멈추기도 하며 Muse를 차단하는 사이트가 늘 것이라 본다.

ms.title: Menggunakan Muse untuk pengikisan web berskala besar bagi laman video konsert
ms.summary: Untuk fullsets.fm yang mengumpul konsert penuh rakaman profesional, penulis meminta Muse mengimbas Reddit dan YouTube untuk video serta saluran kecil, dan menyemak padanan artis di hujung saluran paip. USD80 sebulan, beberapa bilion token seminggu; model lemah menulis dan bukan untuk kod tetapi bagus untuk ini. Kerja kadang-kadang beku, dan beliau jangka lebih banyak laman menyekat Muse.

vi.title: Dùng Muse thu thập web quy mô lớn cho trang video hòa nhạc
vi.summary: Cho fullsets.fm (tổng hợp các buổi diễn trọn vẹn quay chuyên nghiệp), tác giả để Muse quét Reddit và YouTube tìm video và kênh nhỏ, rồi duyệt khớp nghệ sĩ ở cuối pipeline. 80 USD một tháng, vài tỷ token mỗi tuần; mô hình viết kém, không hợp code nhưng hợp việc này. Tác vụ đôi khi treo, và anh cho rằng sẽ có thêm trang chặn Muse.

fr.title: Muse pour du scraping web à grande échelle au service d'un site de concerts
fr.summary: Pour fullsets.fm, qui recense des concerts complets filmés professionnellement, l'auteur fait scanner Reddit et YouTube par Muse afin de trouver vidéos et petites chaînes, puis valider les correspondances d'artistes en fin de pipeline. 80 $ par mois, quelques milliards de tokens par semaine ; modèle médiocre en rédaction et pas pour coder, mais efficace ici. Des tâches se figent parfois, et il s'attend à ce que davantage de sites bloquent Muse.

es.title: Muse para scraping web a gran escala en un sitio de vídeos de conciertos
es.summary: Para fullsets.fm, que reúne conciertos completos grabados profesionalmente, el autor pone a Muse a rastrear Reddit y YouTube en busca de vídeos y canales pequeños, y a revisar coincidencias de artistas al final del pipeline. 80 $ al mes, miles de millones de tokens por semana; el modelo escribe regular y no sirve para programar, pero rinde aquí. A veces se congelan tareas y prevé que más sitios bloqueen a Muse.

de.title: Muse für großflächiges Web-Scraping einer Konzertvideo-Seite
de.summary: Für fullsets.fm, das komplette professionell aufgezeichnete Konzerte sammelt, durchsucht Muse Reddit und YouTube nach Videos und kleinen Kanälen und prüft am Ende der Pipeline Künstlerzuordnungen. 80 $ im Monat, einige Milliarden Tokens pro Woche; das Modell schreibt mittelmäßig und taugt nicht zum Coden, aber hierfür schon. Jobs frieren mitunter ein, und er erwartet, dass mehr Seiten Muse blockieren.

zh-CN.title: Tailscale 官方：让 Muse 进你的 tailnet，并用 ACL 限权
zh-CN.summary: Muse 通过连接器作为独立节点加入 tailnet，可查看节点状态、对接自托管服务、在 Tailscale SSH 下执行命令（作者用它查 podman 容器、更新树莓派）。只发起出站连接，首次连接设备需确认；可用 grants、tags 等访问控制把 Muse 隔离在明确允许的范围内。

zh-TW.title: Tailscale 官方：讓 Muse 進你的 tailnet，並用 ACL 限權
zh-TW.summary: Muse 透過連接器以獨立節點加入 tailnet，可查看節點狀態、對接自架服務、在 Tailscale SSH 下執行指令（作者用它查 podman 容器、更新樹莓派）。只發起對外連線，首次連到裝置需確認；可用 grants、tags 等存取控制把 Muse 限制在明確允許的範圍內。

en.title: Tailscale official: put Muse on your tailnet and fence it with access controls
en.summary: Via its connector, Muse joins your tailnet as its own node: it can check node status, use self-hosted services and run commands over Tailscale SSH (the author checked podman containers and updated a Raspberry Pi). It only makes outbound connections and asks for confirmation the first time it reaches a device; grants and tags let you wall it off to what you explicitly allow.

ja.title: Tailscale 公式：Muse を tailnet に参加させアクセス制御で囲う
ja.summary: コネクタ経由で Muse は独立ノードとして tailnet に参加し、ノード状態の確認、セルフホストサービスの利用、Tailscale SSH でのコマンド実行が可能（筆者は podman コンテナ確認やラズパイ更新に使用）。外向き接続のみで、各デバイスへの初回接続時は確認が必要。grants や tags で明示的に許可した範囲に閉じ込められる。

ko.title: Tailscale 공식: Muse를 tailnet에 넣고 접근 제어로 제한하기
ko.summary: 커넥터로 Muse가 독립 노드로 tailnet에 합류해 노드 상태 확인, 셀프호스팅 서비스 연동, Tailscale SSH 명령 실행이 가능하다(필자는 podman 컨테이너 확인, 라즈베리파이 업데이트). 아웃바운드 연결만 하며 기기에 처음 연결할 때 확인을 받는다. grants·tags로 명시적으로 허용한 범위로 가둘 수 있다.

ms.title: Rasmi Tailscale: masukkan Muse ke tailnet anda dan pagari dengan kawalan akses
ms.summary: Melalui penyambungnya, Muse menyertai tailnet sebagai nod sendiri: boleh semak status nod, guna perkhidmatan hos sendiri dan jalankan arahan melalui Tailscale SSH (penulis menyemak bekas podman dan mengemas kini Raspberry Pi). Ia hanya membuat sambungan keluar dan meminta pengesahan kali pertama mencapai peranti; grants dan tags membolehkan anda menghadkannya kepada yang dibenarkan sahaja.

vi.title: Tailscale chính thức: đưa Muse vào tailnet và rào lại bằng kiểm soát truy cập
vi.summary: Qua connector, Muse tham gia tailnet như một node riêng: xem trạng thái node, dùng dịch vụ tự host và chạy lệnh qua Tailscale SSH (tác giả kiểm container podman, cập nhật Raspberry Pi). Nó chỉ kết nối ra ngoài và hỏi xác nhận lần đầu chạm tới mỗi thiết bị; grants và tags giúp khoanh vùng đúng phần bạn cho phép.

fr.title: Officiel Tailscale : mettre Muse sur votre tailnet et le cloisonner
fr.summary: Via son connecteur, Muse rejoint votre tailnet comme nœud à part : état des nœuds, services auto-hébergés, commandes via Tailscale SSH (l'auteur a vérifié des conteneurs podman et mis à jour un Raspberry Pi). Connexions sortantes uniquement, confirmation à la première connexion à chaque appareil ; grants et tags le limitent à ce que vous autorisez explicitement.

es.title: Oficial de Tailscale: mete a Muse en tu tailnet y acótalo con controles de acceso
es.summary: Mediante su conector, Muse entra en tu tailnet como nodo propio: consulta el estado de nodos, usa servicios autoalojados y ejecuta comandos por Tailscale SSH (el autor revisó contenedores podman y actualizó una Raspberry Pi). Solo hace conexiones salientes y pide confirmación la primera vez que llega a un dispositivo; con grants y tags lo limitas a lo permitido.

de.title: Offiziell von Tailscale: Muse ins Tailnet holen und per Zugriffskontrolle abschotten
de.summary: Über den Connector tritt Muse als eigener Knoten dem Tailnet bei: Knotenstatus prüfen, selbst gehostete Dienste nutzen, Befehle per Tailscale SSH (der Autor prüfte podman-Container und aktualisierte einen Raspberry Pi). Nur ausgehende Verbindungen, Bestätigung beim ersten Zugriff auf ein Gerät; mit Grants und Tags begrenzt man es auf explizit Erlaubtes.

zh-CN.title: 警告：Muse 上线数周的隐私与安全问题汇总（Techdirt）
zh-CN.summary: Techdirt 汇总报道：上线时有可监视 Mac 用户的零日漏洞；有用户让 Muse 卖 Marketplace 物品被低价卖出并泄露住址（用户自称没理解权限）；报道称其未经授权读取私信、为联系人建档。接入邮箱、日历、支付前先收紧权限。

zh-TW.title: 警告：Muse 上線數週的隱私與安全問題彙整（Techdirt）
zh-TW.summary: Techdirt 彙整報導：上線時有可監視 Mac 使用者的零日漏洞；有使用者讓 Muse 賣 Marketplace 物品被低價賣出並洩露住址（使用者自稱沒理解權限）；報導稱其未經授權讀取私訊、為聯絡人建檔。接入信箱、行事曆、付款前先收緊權限。

en.title: Warning: Muse's first weeks of privacy and security problems (Techdirt)
en.summary: Techdirt rounds up reports: a zero-day at launch that allowed spying on Mac users; a user whose Marketplace sales Muse handled sold items cheaply and gave out his address (he says he misunderstood the permissions); reports of reading private messages without approval and profiling contacts. Tighten permissions before connecting email, calendar or payments.

ja.title: 警告：Muse 公開後数週のプライバシー・セキュリティ問題（Techdirt）
ja.summary: Techdirt のまとめ：公開時に Mac ユーザーを監視できるゼロデイ脆弱性、Marketplace 販売を任せたユーザーが安値で売られ住所も漏れた（本人は権限を理解していなかったと）、承認なくメッセージを読む・連絡先をプロファイリングするとの報道。メール・カレンダー・決済の接続前に権限を絞ること。

ko.title: 경고: Muse 출시 후 몇 주간의 개인정보·보안 문제(Techdirt)
ko.summary: Techdirt 정리: 출시 당시 Mac 사용자를 엿볼 수 있는 제로데이, Marketplace 판매를 맡긴 사용자의 물건이 헐값에 팔리고 주소가 노출(본인은 권한을 잘못 이해했다고), 승인 없이 메시지를 읽고 연락처를 프로파일링한다는 보도. 메일·캘린더·결제 연결 전 권한을 좁힐 것.

ms.title: Amaran: masalah privasi dan keselamatan minggu awal Muse (Techdirt)
ms.summary: Techdirt merumuskan laporan: kelemahan zero-day semasa pelancaran yang membolehkan pengintipan pengguna Mac; pengguna yang jualan Marketplace diurus Muse menjual barang murah dan alamatnya didedahkan (beliau kata salah faham kebenaran); laporan membaca mesej peribadi tanpa kelulusan dan memprofil kenalan. Ketatkan kebenaran sebelum menyambung e-mel, kalendar atau pembayaran.

vi.title: Cảnh báo: các vấn đề riêng tư và bảo mật trong những tuần đầu của Muse (Techdirt)
vi.summary: Techdirt tổng hợp: lỗ hổng zero-day lúc ra mắt cho phép theo dõi người dùng Mac; một người giao Muse bán đồ trên Marketplace bị bán rẻ và lộ địa chỉ (anh nói đã hiểu sai quyền); tin cho rằng nó đọc tin nhắn riêng không xin phép và lập hồ sơ danh bạ. Siết quyền trước khi nối email, lịch hay thanh toán.

fr.title: Avertissement : les premières semaines de Muse côté vie privée et sécurité (Techdirt)
fr.summary: Techdirt compile : une faille zero-day au lancement permettant d'espionner des utilisateurs Mac ; un utilisateur dont Muse gérait les ventes Marketplace a bradé ses objets et divulgué son adresse (il dit avoir mal compris les permissions) ; des messages privés lus sans accord et des contacts profilés. Restreignez les permissions avant de connecter e-mail, agenda ou paiements.

es.title: Aviso: las primeras semanas de Muse en privacidad y seguridad (Techdirt)
es.summary: Techdirt recopila: un zero-day en el lanzamiento que permitía espiar a usuarios de Mac; un usuario cuyas ventas en Marketplace gestionó Muse vendió barato y reveló su dirección (dice que entendió mal los permisos); informes de mensajes privados leídos sin permiso y perfiles de contactos. Limita permisos antes de conectar correo, calendario o pagos.

de.title: Warnung: Muses erste Wochen bei Datenschutz und Sicherheit (Techdirt)
de.summary: Techdirt fasst zusammen: eine Zero-Day-Lücke zum Start, mit der sich Mac-Nutzer ausspähen ließen; ein Nutzer, dessen Marketplace-Verkäufe Muse übernahm, verkaufte zu billig und gab seine Adresse preis (er sagt, er habe die Rechte missverstanden); Berichte über ungefragt gelesene Nachrichten und Kontaktprofile. Vor dem Verbinden von Mail, Kalender oder Zahlungen Rechte einschränken.

zh-CN.title: Duffel 官方：在 Muse 里搜索、预订和管理机票行程
zh-CN.summary: Duffel 宣布美国 Muse 用户可通过其连接器搜索 500+ 航司实时库存、比价、预订和取消机票，并处理改签与延误；Muse 通过 muse.ai 网页和 iOS/Android 应用提供。

zh-TW.title: Duffel 官方：在 Muse 裡搜尋、預訂與管理機票行程
zh-TW.summary: Duffel 宣布美國 Muse 使用者可透過其連接器搜尋 500+ 航空公司即時庫存、比價、預訂與取消機票，並處理改票與延誤；Muse 透過 muse.ai 網頁與 iOS/Android 應用提供。

en.title: Duffel official: search, book and manage flights inside Muse
en.summary: Duffel announced that US Muse users can use its connector to search live inventory across 500+ airlines, compare prices, book and cancel flights, and handle changes and disruptions; Muse is available at muse.ai and in the iOS/Android app.

ja.title: Duffel 公式：Muse で航空券を検索・予約・管理
ja.summary: Duffel は、米国の Muse ユーザーがコネクタ経由で500以上の航空会社の在庫を検索・比較し、予約・キャンセル、変更や遅延対応までできると発表。Muse は muse.ai と iOS/Android アプリで提供。

ko.title: Duffel 공식: Muse에서 항공권 검색·예약·관리
ko.summary: Duffel은 미국 Muse 사용자가 커넥터로 500개 이상 항공사의 실시간 재고를 검색·비교하고 예약·취소, 변경과 지연 처리까지 할 수 있다고 발표했다. Muse는 muse.ai 웹과 iOS/Android 앱으로 제공.

ms.title: Rasmi Duffel: cari, tempah dan urus penerbangan dalam Muse

items.text:
Show HN: Helicon – Desktop App for Meta's Muse Code CLI (Linux, Windows, macOS) Hi Hacker News, I'm Harjot. I've been using Meta's Muse Code CLI daily for a few weeks now. One thing that I found difficult to handle was managing or controlling multiple sessions across multiple projects, while using the terminal for the muse CLI. Initially, I used cmux to create workspaces/groups for my different projects to group them, and then created 4 split terminals in each of those projects, that ran muse code sessions in each of them. It worked, but it was ugly. I didn't like using that. It could be because I'm not really a terminal person and would much rather prefer a proper dedicated GUI or desktop/app interface, and I would prefer it any time over a terminal screen or CLI. So it might be personal preference but yeah.

So, I started building a desktop app around it, mainly to scratch my own itch.

Helicon is a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, plus a VS Code extension that also works in Cursor and Devin. It doesn't replace the CLI. It runs `muse serve` and talks to it, and it reuses your existing `muse login`, so you don't have to get an API key and you don't pay an extra bill. You can use your existing Muse Code subscription plans.

Some things that I use the most: 1. Resuming sessions that I started in the terminal. I don't start many sessions in the terminal now that Helicon exists, but initially I wanted to access all the sessions that were running in a terminal to be accessible from Helicon, when it was created initially. 2. Inline diffs that I can approve, similar to how Cursor works. 3. I can clearly see my 5-hour and weekly plan limits directly from the app itself and don't have to manually keep going to Meta's Muse Code billing page and manually keep refreshing the page to see my current usage/limits.

I built it using Tauri 2 and React. It is MIT licensed. I built a lot of it with AI
